segments.sn48.4:1.4: Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ assādañca [samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.) saṃ. ni. 2.175] ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimutto hoti –
segments.sn48.4:1.5: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto”ti.
